scenarios.title: Sale-open spike
scenarios.shape: Buyers join during the pre-queue, then poll as the server says
scenarios.budget: Queue status p99 < 50 ms, no error other than 429

scenarios.title: Buy flow
scenarios.shape: Admitted buyers: hold (30 % on the same hot seats) → order → mock pay, double clicks included
scenarios.budget: Hold p99 < 150 ms, checkout p99 < 300 ms

scenarios.title: Webhook storm
scenarios.shape: Every payment webhook 3× in parallel, then 3× again after a random 0–5 min delay

scenarios.title: Soak
scenarios.shape: Moderate constant load; half the holds are left to expire
scenarios.budget: Memory and GC stable, no growth in Redis hold keys

scenarios.title: Chaos
scenarios.shape: Buy flow while the worker leader is killed, Redis restarts and Postgres pauses 10 s
scenarios.budget: The system recovers and the invariants hold
